```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from math import sqrt,pi,erfc
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
data=np.array([-4,-2,-1,0,0,1,1,2,3,3,4,4,5,6,8,10]);sigma=4;n=len(data);se=sigma/sqrt(n)
z=data.mean()/se;critical=1.959963984540054;p=erfc(abs(z)/sqrt(2))
assert n==16 and data.mean()==2.5 and se==1 and np.isclose(p,.01241933065)
x=np.linspace(-4.8,4.8,2401);density=np.exp(-.5*x*x)/sqrt(2*pi)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.7),layout='constrained')
ax.plot(x,density,color='#555555',lw=2)
ax.fill_between(x,0,density,where=abs(x)>=critical,color='#edcbb1')
ax.fill_between(x,0,density,where=abs(x)>=z,color='#006699',alpha=.8)
ax.vlines([-critical,critical],0,.415,color='#b64b29',ls='--',lw=1.7)
ax.vlines(z,0,.48,color='#006699',lw=2.1)
ax.vlines(-z,0,.285,color='#006699',ls=':',lw=1.8)
ax.axvline(0,ymax=.69,color='#777777',ls=':',lw=1)
ax.text(0,.465,'Regla: límits de ±1,96 cm',ha='center',color='#b64b29',fontsize=14)
for bound in [-critical,critical]:
    ax.annotate('',(bound,.418),(bound*.7,.448),arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'#b64b29','lw':1.2})
ax.annotate('Resultat observat\n+2,5 cm',(z,.46),xytext=(3.55,.48),ha='center',va='top',color='#006699',fontsize=14,
            arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'#006699'})
ax.annotate('Igual de lluny del zero\na l’altre costat',(-z,.27),xytext=(-3.4,.35),ha='center',va='top',
            color='#006699',fontsize=13,arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'#006699'})
ax.text(0,.14,'Mitjanes habituals\nprop de 0 cm',ha='center',fontsize=13,
        bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','pad':1})
ax.set(xlim=(-4.8,4.8),ylim=(0,.53),yticks=[],xticks=[-4,-2,0,2,4],
       xlabel='Error mitjà d’un grup de 16 lectures (cm)',
       title='Comprovació d’una cinta sobre un tram de 20 m')
ax.spines[['top','right','left']].set_visible(False)
handles=[Line2D([],[],color='#b64b29',ls='--',lw=1.7,label='Límits escollits abans de mesurar'),
         Patch(facecolor='#006699',alpha=.8,label='Zones blaves: 1,24% en total')]
fig.legend(handles=handles,loc='outside lower center',ncol=1,frameon=False,fontsize=13)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/contrast-hipotesi.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
